environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate with 4 replicas behind an ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with connection pooling via PgBouncer 1.21 in transaction mode (pool_mode=transaction). PgBouncer max_client_conn=400, default_pool_size=20. No database-level advisory locks configured. Standard pg driver with no explicit transaction isolation level set (defaults to READ COMMITTED). Auto-scaling triggers at 70% CPU, meaning concurrent requests are distributed across multiple application instances each maintaining their own connection pool to PgBouncer.
